title: Grid Drop
description: Drag three block pieces at a time onto an 8x8 board, clear full rows and columns, chain combos and race to 1000 points.
controls: Drag a piece from the tray onto the board. Fill a row or column to clear it; back-to-back clears build a combo. The run ends when no piece fits.

zh-CN.title: 方格落块
zh-CN.description: 每次给三块方块，拖到 8×8 棋盘上，填满整行或整列即消除，连续消除叠连击，冲到 1000 分获胜。
zh-CN.controls: 从下方拖动方块放到棋盘上，填满整行或整列即可消除，连续消除有连击加成；三块都放不下时游戏结束。
